title: National-scale ERP for a government department
summary: A modular ERP covering HR, finance, procurement and citizen-facing workflows for a public-sector department — strict role hierarchies, immutable audit trails and secure on-premise deployment where the data never leaves the building.

title: WhatsApp & email automation engine
summary: An omnichannel automation platform driving contextual WhatsApp and email journeys — template governance, rate-aware throttling, delivery analytics and human-takeover built in from the first release.

title: HIPAA-grade multi-tenant data platform
summary: A database-per-tenant architecture for a healthcare SaaS — field-level encryption, PHI access controls, consent tracking and full audit trails, with automated tenant provisioning and tested disaster recovery.

title: Agentic RAG knowledge assistant
summary: A hybrid-search RAG assistant over 200k+ internal documents — LangGraph agents with tool use, citation-grounded answers and eval-gated releases, so accuracy is measured instead of assumed.
